title: Can Light Push an Object?
description:
Light has no rest mass, yet photons can exert pressure.

Yes. Photons carry momentum and transfer it when absorbed or reflected, creating radiation pressure.

The force is tiny for everyday light but measurable; high-power lasers and solar sails can accumulate meaningful effects.

Reflecting light transfers more momentum than absorbing the same light.
